## Why visit

A genuine community-pub alternative to modern micropubs, with intimate rooms, local character and a view towards the Dee Estuary. Its 2025 Wirral CAMRA Community Pub Award supports its inclusion, while the cask choice makes it more than a scenic detour. Combine with The Beer Lab if exploring cider in Heswall, but factor in the distance from the railway station.

## Beer

Black Sheep Best Bitter and London Pride regularly listed, plus changing cask beers.

## Cider and perry

**Real-cider offering not established.** No qualifying real-cider selection established in the current listing.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Food

No kitchen; CAMRA explicitly allows customers to bring food or order takeaway.

## Plan the visit

CAMRA lists opening from early afternoon daily. Tuesday is an advertised cask-club day, but verify the discount and event status.

**Getting there:** Near Heswall centre; the railway station is significantly farther away than the nearby bus stops.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
